text:
Marta: hey team, urgent — need to hop offline in ~20m. unexpected family thing. i'm primary for tonight but can’t cover the overnight window. can someone take primary tonight? i can do a 20–30m overlap to hand off context. :disappointed:
Jae: @Marta sorry to hear that, hope all ok. i can swap and take primary if Priya/Sam are good with a quick handover now. :wave:
Priya: I can be secondary for the night and shadow during the handoff. Jae — you cool with the current mitigation state?
Marta: thanks @Jae @Priya. current state: we have a persistent elevated 5xx rate on embeddings-service-usw2 (~3% vs baseline 0.2%) since ~17:40 UTC. mitigation so far: scaled svc from 3->6 replicas, enabled prefix cache bypass for a suspect model shard, and kicked an async resync of read-replicas (db-regen job) — currently queued. logs and steps in runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/embeddings-5xx-resync
Sam: tagging in. are there any customer-facing errors? support said two customers saw timeouts but no data loss.
Marta: support reported degraded latency and some timeouts, but no write failures. incident-bot also flagged ~90 traces with error code E-EMB-502 in the last 10m.
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service-usw2 error rate above threshold (3.1%). Pager sent to primary. Incident severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1789992345
Jae: ok good to know. @rotation-bot can you confirm I’m set as primary once Marta signs off?
rotation-bot: rotation update queued. Confirm swap request: Marta -> Jae for window 17:50-08:00 UTC. Primary assignment will switch after both confirm handoff. :white_check_mark:
Marta: quick runbook snippets for handoff: 1) watch: grafana -> infl-embeddings -> error_rate / latency (alert dashboard). 2) if 5xx persists after scaling, run db resync monitor:
```
# check db-regen job
kubectl -n inference get jobs | grep db-regen
kubectl -n inference logs job/db-regen-2026-03-15 --tail=200
```
3) to force a safe fallback to model-variant-v1: set routing flag: `rbacctl set routing embeddings-service --variant v1 --reason "fallback during regen"`
Jae: copying runbook. couple clarifying q's: who has keys for KMS rotate if we need to rotate embedding keys? and do we have any outstanding canary rollouts for embeddings that'd be affected?
Marta: KMS rotate is with Priya (we've used customer-managed KMS). no active canary for embeddings tonight.
Priya: confirmed I can do KMS if needed. also I’ll keep an eye on the db-regen job until it completes. please paste any relevant logs in thread.
Sam: i'll monitor support queue and throttle/backpressure rules on the API gateway in case we need to soften client retries. command I use to check gateway throttles:
```
# api gateway throttle status
curl -sS https://api-gateway.internal/metrics | jq '.throttles.embeddings'
```
Jae: taking pager now. I'll be primary and respond to pages. @Marta can you hand over any open terminal sessions or leftover notes?
Marta: pasted a couple of useful commands and the last error snippet below before i run:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T17:42:09Z embedding-worker: shard-7 failed to pull weights: checksum mismatch, fallback triggered. trace_id=tx-9f3a
TRACE: https://traces.dev/tx-9f3a
```
and the db-regen job id is `db-regen-2026-03-15-1742` — queued on node pool `io-heavy-2`.
Jae: got it. i'll watch that trace and the regen job. Priya — if regen fails, do you want me to escalate to infra for a manual attach to the io pool?
Priya: yes please. if regen fails after 2 attempts, escalate and open a ticket with infra on-call. steps in runbook under "regen failure -> escalate".
rotation-bot: NOTE: Jae confirmed primary. Marta confirmed handover complete. Swap effective at 17:55 UTC with 15m overlap.
Jae: confirming — i am primary now. i’ll take the pager and lead mitigation. Priya — you’re secondary and will take KMS/infra escalation. Sam — you’re on support liaison and gateway throttles.
Sam: acked, monitoring support, will post any customer hits here.
Marta: thanks all. i’m signing off now. ping me if things blow up and i’ll do my best to join. :heart:
incident-bot: NOTE: pager reassigned to Jae (primary). Remember to acknowledge incidents in the incident system: `incctl ack 1789992345`
Jae: acked and running initial checks. first steps: 1) confirm db-regen moved from queued->running within 10m, 2) check the error rate trend on grafana, 3) if still >1% after regen, put routing flag to v1 fallback. posting updates here every ~10m.
Priya: standing by for KMS actions and infra escalate if needed.
Sam: standing by for support updates. current support ticket #INC-4532 — 2 affected customers, both onus on embeddings-v2.
Jae: update 18:04 UTC — db-regen job transitioned to Running. logs show resync started. error rate trending down: 3.1% -> 1.4% in last 6m. will continue to monitor.
Marta: thanks team — good handoff. safe travels.
Jae: update 18:24 UTC — regen finished successfully. 5xx dropped to 0.25% and latency normalized. closing handoff monitor. will keep oncall notes updated in Confluence.
Priya: confirmed. I'll stay until midnight overlap to watch KMS and infra alarms.
rotation-bot: swap complete. Next rotation: scheduled as usual. Good job team. :tada:
